knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

Loading all libraries required

```{r}
library(terra)
library(predicts)
library(rJava)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)
```


## Training the model based on Maxent
```{r}
# Predictor variables
e <- ext(-179, 179, -59, 83) #left, right, bottom, top
#r <- rast(res=1/48, ext=e) #an empty raster
fl.ext<-c(-90, -75, 24, 36)

biosoil<-rast("C:/Users/plexaaron/UFL Dropbox/Aaron Plex Sula/168/2022/2022 Projects/Pathogen biogeography/Model validation/biosoilvar.tif")
env.fl<-crop(biosoil, fl.ext)
biosoil<-aggregate(biosoil, fact = 20, fun = mean, na.rm=TRUE)

# Geographic coordinates of occurrences
geo.presence <- read.csv("C:/Users/plexaaron/UFL Dropbox/Aaron Plex Sula/168/2022/2022 Projects/Pathogen biogeography/Model validation/Ralstonia solanacearum/Ralstonia_Global_Diversity_Current_7_29.csv")
## Focusing the analysis on sequevar 1 (Ralstonia solanacearum race 3 biovar 2)
geo.presence<-geo.presence[geo.presence$Sequevar == "1",]
## Focusing the analysis on sub-national occurrences and unique geographic coordinates
countries <- unique(geo.presence$Location..Country.or.Territory.)
geo.presence <- geo.presence[!geo.presence$Location.Isolated %in% countries,]
geo.presence <- geo.presence[, c("Latitude", "Longitude")]
geo.presence <- geo.presence[!duplicated(geo.presence[, c("Longitude", "Latitude")]), ]

plot(geo.presence$Longitude, geo.presence$Latitude, 
     xlab = "Longitude", ylab = "Latitude",
     main = "Occurrence of RS sequevar 1")

#vectorPresence<-vect(geo.presence, 
#                 crs="+proj=longlat", geom=c("Longitude","Latitude"))
#vectorPresence<-crop(vectorPresence, e)
vectorPresence <- vect(geo.presence, geom = c("Longitude", "Latitude"),
                       crs  = "EPSG:4326")
writeVector(vectorPresence, filename = "RSIIB1_occurrences.shp", overwrite = TRUE)

# Building the maxent model
ks<-ifelse(length(geo.presence$Latitude)<=150, 5, 
           ifelse(length(geo.presence$Latitude)<1500, 10,
                  ifelse(length(geo.presence$Latitude)<2000, 15, 20)))
fold<-folds(vectorPresence, k = ks)
occ.test<-vectorPresence[fold == 1,]
occ.train<-vectorPresence[fold != 1,]
background.points<-40*dim(vectorPresence)[1] #Check that there are at least 8,000 background points

maxent.model<-MaxEnt(biosoil[[1:10]], occ.train, nbg = background.points,
                     removeDuplicates = FALSE, silent = TRUE)
plot(maxent.model) #plot of the importance of variables

par(mfrow = c(3,2))
hist(maxent.model@presence$Isothermality, xlab = "Isothermality", main = "")
hist(maxent.model@presence$AM_Temperature, xlab = "Annual mean temperature", main = "")
hist(maxent.model@presence$Precipitation_seasonality, xlab = "Precipitation seasonality", main = "")
hist(maxent.model@presence$Annual_precipitation, xlab = "Annual precipitation", main = "")
hist(maxent.model@presence$MDiurnal_Range, xlab = "Mean diurnal temperature range", main = "")
```


## Predicting distribution based on climate similarity
```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
logistic.map<-predict(maxent.model, biosoil, args=c("outputformat=logistic"))
logistic.fl<-predict(maxent.model, env.fl, args=c("outputformat=logistic"))
writeRaster(logistic.fl, "RSIIB1-Maxent-FL.tif", overwrite = TRUE)
vir.pal<-viridis(n=100, option = "viridis")

par(mfrow = c(2,2))
plot(vectorPresence, col = vir.pal, main = "Observed distribution")
plot(logistic.map, col = vir.pal, main = "Predicted distribution")
plot(logistic.map, col = vir.pal, main = "Training dataset")
points(occ.train, col = "grey60")
plot(logistic.map, col = vir.pal, main = "Test dataset")
points(occ.test, col = "red")
```

# Contemporary risk scenario
```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
map_grey_background <- rast("C:/Users/plexaaron/UFL Dropbox/Aaron Plex Sula/168/2022/2022 Projects/Pathogen biogeography/Predictor variables/map_grey_background.tif")
map_grey_background <- project(map_grey_background,
                               "+proj=robin +lon_0=0 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")

logistic.map<-project(logistic.map, "+proj=robin +lon_0=0 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")
myPalette2 <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "Spectral")),space="Lab")

plot(map_grey_background, col = "grey75",  xaxt='n',  yaxt='n', axes=F, box=F, legend = F, main = "Projected risk in 2010")
plot(logistic.map^(1/2), col=myPalette2(100), xaxt = 'n', yaxt = 'n', axes = F, box = F, add = T, legend = T, plg = list(loc = "bottom", horizontal = TRUE))
writeRaster(logistic.map, "RSIIB1MaxENT.tif", overwrite=TRUE)
```


# Climate change scenario
```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
future.climate<-geodata::cmip6_world(model = "ACCESS-ESM1-5", ssp = "585", time = "2061-2080", var = "bioc", res = 10, path = tempdir())
future.climate<-crop(future.climate, e)
future.climate<-list(future.climate$bio01, future.climate$bio02, future.climate$bio03, future.climate$bio12, future.climate$bio15, biosoil$`sand_15-30cm`, biosoil$`phh2o_15-30cm`,biosoil$`clay_15-30cm`,biosoil$`silt_15-30cm`,biosoil$`soc_15-30cm`,biosoil$travel_time_to_cities_1,biosoil$travel_time_to_ports_1)
future.climate<-terra::rast(future.climate)
names(future.climate)<-names(biosoil)

future.logimap<-predict(maxent.model, future.climate, args=c("outputformat=logistic"))
future.logimap<-project(future.logimap, "+proj=robin +lon_0=0 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")

plot(map_grey_background, col = "grey75",  xaxt='n',  yaxt='n', axes=F, box=F, legend = F, main = "Projected risk in 2061-2080")
plot(future.logimap^(1/2), col=myPalette2(100), xaxt = 'n', yaxt = 'n', axes = F, box = F, add = T, legend = T, plg = list(loc = "bottom", horizontal = TRUE))

vir.diff<-viridis(n=100, option = "cividis")
diff.map<-(future.logimap - logistic.map) * 100

plot(map_grey_background, col = "grey75",  xaxt='n',  yaxt='n', axes=F, box=F, legend = F, main = "% change in projected risk")
plot(diff.map, col=vir.diff, xaxt = 'n', yaxt = 'n', axes = F, box = F, add = T, legend = T, plg = list(loc = "bottom", horizontal = TRUE))
```
